actions.reason: Urgent Field Safety Notice for HeartMate 3 LVAS Implant Kit, HeartMate 3 Pump by Thoratec Corporation

We have received reports of closure of the outflow graft due to twist (twist) in the HeartMate 3 (HM3) Left Ventricular Assist System (LVAS). As a result of this closure of the outflow graft, these patients have a persistent alarm message for low flow.

We have established that there is a possibility of a communication error between the patient's system operation and the support heart, causing an alarm message about a communication fault ( COM Fault) to appear on the system control.

Abbott has identified cases where the bend relief of the outflow cannula (OGBR - Outflow Graft Bend Relief) of the HeartMate 3 (HM3) Left Ventricular Assist System (LVAS) is not fully and evenly attached to the outflow cannula.
